t: Ritz Camera - Camera-wiki.org - The free camera encyclopedia
s: Ritz Camera was a former chain of retail camera stores based in the United States. From their 1936 roots in the Washington, DC, area,[1] Ritz and their sub-brands eventually grew to be the largest photo retail chain in the country, peaking at around 1,200 stores.
